quality_weight_diagnostics.standardized_two_snapshot_weight_rule: For two unequal losses, population-standardized z scores approach +/-1, so beta=3 yields softmax(-3,+3) ~= (0.002472623,0.997527377), regardless of nonzero loss-gap magnitude.
